ns2:course.label: Advanced Television Reporting
ns2:course.description: Build on your reporting skills learned in other classes. Advanced techniques for television reporting, writing, shooting and editing video news stories. Learn how to find, research better video stories for air. Then present stories on air for UI7 Newsroom programming. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: JOUR 340. May not be taken concurrently with JOUR 400-UI7 Newsroom classes.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: JOUR 340. May not be taken concurrently with JOUR 400-UI7 Newsroom classes.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Journalism major(s). Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing.
